$comment: Every client source that produces a floating layer, with the decision the coordinator migration took for it. `pnpm check:webui-overlays` fails on a surface that is not listed, on a `managed` entry whose source never registers, and on an exception without its interaction boundary. `--strict` fails while any entry is pending.

dispositions.managed: registers with the coordinator and attaches no listener
dispositions.borrows-role: renders role="dialog" for labelling, is not a layer
dispositions.exception: cannot join; its interaction boundary is stated
dispositions.pending: not migrated yet; the reason is recorded

ui/field.tsx.note: the shared select menu uses the dropdown coordinator for dismissal and focus return

features/account/ui/AccountLoginPage.tsx.note: the sign-in page registers with the coordinator as a full-viewport layer and attaches no listener of its own

features/account/ui/UserMenu.tsx.note: the account menu layers on the shared dropdown and closes its fly-outs on every close; the two fly-outs borrow role=dialog for labelling only and live inside that layer, and the portalled settings modal registers its own layer

features/account/ui/UserMenuUsage.tsx.note: renders role=dialog for labelling only: it is a hover/focus fly-out inside the account menu's layer and is dismissed by that menu, not by itself

features/composer/ui/ComposerEditorStagi.note: the mention and command menus; the composer region carries both layer ids

features/composer/ui/ComposerProjectRow..note: the project menu layers on the shared dropdown, and the directory browser it opens is a modal layer of its own, so the coordinator dismisses it and it holds no listener

features/goal/ui/GoalBanner.public.tsx.note: the delete-goal confirmation uses WebuiDialog with shared scrim, fixed actions and a deferred dismissal policy while deletion is in flight

features/models/ui/ModelPicker.public.ts.note: one layer with a ladder of its own: request-close walks list to panel, a press outside closes

features/models/ui/ProviderFormPanel.pub.note: provider editor and delete confirmation use WebuiDialog; the preset and format pickers remain nested managed popovers

features/plugins/ui/PluginManagementList.note: row action menus use one managed dropdown layer at a time

features/miniapp/ui/MiniAppAppsList.publ.note: Mini App row action menus use the shared managed dropdown layer

features/channel/ui/ChannelConnectPanel..note: the bot deletion confirmation; a dismissal closes it

features/remote-control/ui/RemoteControl.note: the pairing-code modal; a dismissal closes it

features/plugins/ui/PluginImportDialog.t.note: a modal layer; a dismissal closes it

features/plugins/ui/PluginItemDialog.tsx.note: the plugin editor and the MCP dialog, one layer each mount

features/settings/ui/MemoryManagerDialog.note: the parent and nested confirmation use the shared WebuiDialog shell; the menu names the parent directly, so dialog, menu and confirmation stay one nested path

features/settings/ui/SettingsModal.publi.note: full-page settings host keeps its page-like layout as a documented visual exception and provides a managed parent boundary to nested dialogs

features/settings/ui/settings-atoms.tsx.note: the settings dialog adapter renders the shared WebuiDialog shell; its close policy is passed to the shared coordinator registration

features/settings/ui/UsageModelSettings..note: the model-source menu registers with the coordinator as a layer of the settings page, which is itself a managed parent

features/transcript/ui/MessageActions.ts.note: rewind preview uses WebuiDialog and its fixed shared actions slot

features/transcript/ui/MessageItem.tsx.note: fork dialog uses WebuiDialog and mounts only while active

features/workspace/ui/WorkspaceProgressP.note: commit dialog uses WebuiDialog with shared actions slot

ui/ContextMenu.tsx.note: opened at a point; a press anywhere else ends it

ui/dialog.tsx.note: the shared public modal shell portals into the document body, registers with the coordinator, and delegates inertness/focus containment and restoration to the browser platform

ui/feedback.tsx.boundary: the pending-action overlay is feedback about one command, not a surface the reader opened: it has no dismissal of its own, so it does not register with the coordinator. It portals into the platform's portal target, covers the viewport while the action settles, and leaves with the action's result. It is inert to Escape and outside presses by construction, and a second action cannot start because the control that started it is disabled while it shows.

features/ssh/ui/SshPanel.public.tsx.note: the SSH panel hosts the add, details and removal dialogs; each registers with the coordinator through the shared dialog and attaches no listener of its own

features/ssh/ui/ssh-add-connection-dialo.note: the add-connection dialog registers with the coordinator as a managed layer and attaches no listener of its own

features/ssh/ui/ssh-connection-details-d.note: the connection-details dialog registers with the coordinator as a managed layer and attaches no listener of its own

features/ssh/ui/ssh-project-form.tsx.note: the project form renders through the shared dialog, which registers with the coordinator and owns dismissal

features/ssh/ui/ssh-terminal-view.tsx.note: the remote terminal window renders through the shared dialog, which registers with the coordinator and owns dismissal

features/scheduling/ui/scheduling-editor.note: the scheduled-task form renders through the shared dialog, which registers with the coordinator and owns dismissal

features/ssh/ui/ssh-connection-row.tsx.note: the row's menu is the shared dropdown, which registers with the coordinator and owns its own dismissal
